articles.title: Nigel Farage Skips His Own Victory Party After Winning By-Election
articles.summary: Nigel Farage won an election in Clacton, England, but he didn't show up to celebrate. He said police warned him about a plan to disrupt the event. Some people think he's avoiding questions about his party's money problems.

articles.title: Speed Cameras Are Popping Up Everywhere, and Drivers Are Not Happy
articles.summary: More states are putting speed cameras near schools to make roads safer. But many drivers say the cameras are just a way to make money, especially when they give tickets during school hours when kids are inside.

articles.title: UK Bans Disposable BBQs Because They're Starting Wildfires
articles.summary: The UK has temporarily banned selling disposable barbecues because they've caused many wildfires during the hot, dry summer. The government says it's too risky, and the prime minister says the country is like a 'tinderbox.'
